title: Remakes and Reimaginings
intro: [excited] Welcome to Remakes and Reimaginings! Tonight it's the originals versus the remakes. Same stories, new faces... and a LOT more CGI. [chuckles] Let's see if you've been paying attention, both times.

art.prompt: A grand old movie palace with two side-by-side screens, one glowing with hand-painted watercolor fairy-tale scenery, the other with a photo-realistic version of the same castle and forest, a velvet curtain between them, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

categories.title: The Circle of Remakes
categories.intro: Our film category is The Circle of Remakes! It's all about who stepped into those iconic roles. [mischievously] No pressure, Genie.

art.prompt: A film director's chair on a photo-realistic African savanna at sunrise beside a glowing magic lamp, a seashell microphone and a red rose under glass, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: In 2019's live-action Aladdin, this superstar plays the big blue Genie.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Will Smith! [laughs] Robin Williams had the original 1992 role. Big shoes to fill... and big blue pants.

clues.clue: In 2023's The Little Mermaid, Ariel is played by this singer and actress.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Halle Bailey! [excited] She's also half of the singing duo Chloe x Halle with her sister. Talk about a voice worth trading for legs.

clues.clue: The 2017 Beauty and the Beast stars this former Harry Potter actress as Belle.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Emma Watson! [chuckles] From Hermione's library to the Beast's library. She really loves books.

clues.clue: In 2019's The Lion King, Beyonce voices this lioness.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Nala! [excited] Queen B as a queen lioness. That's just good casting.

clues.clue: This actor is the only main voice from the 1994 Lion King to return for the 2019 remake, reprising Mufasa.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is James Earl Jones! [dramatic pause] Remember who you are. Nobody else could ever sound that much like a king.

categories.title: Then vs. Now
categories.intro: Next up, Then vs. Now! What changed when the cartoons came to life? [sighs] Spoiler: some sidekicks got left behind.

art.prompt: Two halves of one jungle scene: a hand-painted watercolor jungle on the left blending into a photo-realistic jungle on the right, a dalmatian-spotted fur coat on a hanger and a Chinese palace in the distance, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: The 2021 movie Cruella, starring Emma Stone, tells the origin story of the villain who wants a coat made of these spotted puppies.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Dalmatians! [mischievously] She's very stylish, very punk rock... and still not allowed near puppies.

clues.clue: The 2014 film Maleficent retells Sleeping Beauty from the villain's side, starring this actress in the horns.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Angelina Jolie! [laughs] Her real daughter Vivienne played little Aurora, because other kids were scared of her costume.

clues.clue: The 2020 live-action Mulan left out this wisecracking little dragon.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mushu! [sighs] Eddie Murphy's dragon didn't make the cut. A phoenix flew in instead. Dishonor on the whole remake!

clues.clue: In 2016's The Jungle Book, this young actor played Mowgli, the only human actor in most of the film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Neel Sethi! [chuckles] He filmed almost everything on a blue screen stage, acting with puppets and people in blue suits. Bare necessities, indeed.

clues.clue: In 2023's Peter Pan and Wendy on Disney Plus, this actor plays Captain Hook.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Jude Law! [gasps] Tick-tock! Dustin Hoffman played Hook in 1991, but that was a different studio.

categories.title: Picture the Remake
categories.intro: It's our picture category, Picture the Remake! Each scene appears in both the cartoon AND the remake. [excited] Name that film!

art.prompt: A film projector beam shining through floating objects: a glass slipper, a magic lamp, a wooden puppet's hat and a striped circus tent, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Both an animated classic and its live-action remake feature this scene. Name the film.
choices: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Beauty and the Beast! [whispers] When that last petal falls, it's game over. No pressure.

clues.clue: Both an animated classic and its live-action remake feature this scene. Name the film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Aladdin! [mischievously] Rule number one in the Cave of Wonders: touch NOTHING but the lamp.

media.prompt: A vast cave filled with mountains of golden treasure, a dusty brass oil lamp glowing on a rock pedestal at the top of a stone stairway, a rolled carpet resting nearby, original artwork, no people, no characters, no text, no logos

clues.clue: Both an animated classic and its live-action remake feature this scene. Name the film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Cinderella! [laughs] One shoe left on the stairs at midnight. Sizing, people. It matters.

media.prompt: A single sparkling glass slipper resting on the steps of a grand palace staircase at midnight, a clock tower glowing in the background, a pumpkin by the gate, original artwork, no people, no characters, no text, no logos

clues.clue: Both an animated classic and its live-action remake feature this scene. Name the film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Pinocchio! The live-action remake came out in 2022 on Disney Plus. [chuckles] Am I lying? Check my nose.

media.prompt: A cozy old woodcarver's workshop full of hand-carved cuckoo clocks and music boxes, a small wooden puppet's feathered hat on the workbench, a goldfish bowl and a wishing star in the window, original artwork, no people, no characters, no text, no logos

clues.clue: Both an animated classic and its live-action remake feature this scene. Name the film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Dumbo! Tim Burton directed the 2019 remake. [excited] Proof that big ears are a superpower.

media.prompt: A vintage circus big top at night with a tiny clown-painted bucket on a high platform, a single white feather floating in a spotlight, and a train car painted in old circus colors parked outside, original artwork, no people, no characters, no text, no logos

categories.title: Remade in the Parks
categories.intro: Time for the parks: Remade in the Parks! [chuckles] Disney doesn't just remake movies. It remakes RIDES.

art.prompt: A theme park construction scene at twilight: scaffolding around a mountain flume ride, a boat ride entrance being repainted with snowflakes and a submarine lagoon glowing turquoise, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Splash Mountain was reimagined into this Princess and the Frog log flume.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tiana's Bayou Adventure! [excited] It opened in 2024, with music, critters and a party at the end. Dig a little deeper!

clues.clue: In EPCOT's Norway pavilion, the Maelstrom boat ride was reimagined in 2016 as this attraction.
choices: For the First Time in Forever
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Frozen Ever After! [laughs] Goodbye, old trolls and polar bear. Hello, Olaf and a whole lot of snow. Let it go!

clues.clue: In 2021, Disneyland's Snow White's Scary Adventures reopened with this new name.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Snow White's Enchanted Wish! [chuckles] Fewer scares, more wishing. The witch still shows up though. She ALWAYS shows up.

clues.clue: EPCOT's Universe of Energy pavilion was reimagined into this Marvel roller coaster, which opened in 2022.
clues.answer: Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind
accept: guardians of the galaxy cosmic rewind
choices: Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind
Guardians of the Galaxy - Mission: BREAKOUT!
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind! [excited] It goes BACKWARDS and the cars spin to face the action. Bye-bye, Ellen's dinosaurs.

clues.clue: Disneyland's Submarine Voyage was reimagined in 2007 around this Pixar film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Finding Nemo! [whispers] Look out the porthole and you might spot a certain fish who keeps forgetting things. Just keep swimming.

categories.title: Remake Sing-Along
categories.intro: Our fan category is Remake Sing-Along: classic songs and brand-new ones from the remakes. [laughs] I'll try not to sing. I'll fail, but I'll try.

art.prompt: A grand piano on a stage with sheet music swirling up into the air and turning into roses, lanterns and seashells, warm golden spotlight, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: In 2019's The Lion King, Timon and Pumbaa teach young Simba this carefree song, which means no worries.
choices: I Just Can't Wait to Be King
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Hakuna Matata! [laughs] Billy Eichner and Seth Rogen took over the grub-loving duo. Still no worries, for the rest of your days.

clues.clue: Naomi Scott's Jasmine gets this powerful new solo in 2019's Aladdin.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Speechless! [excited] Written by Alan Menken with the La La Land songwriters. Jasmine will not be silenced!

clues.clue: The new song Wild Uncharted Waters in 2023's The Little Mermaid is sung by this character.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Prince Eric! [laughs] Finally, the prince gets his own song. He's singing about the sea. Again. Guy's got one topic.

clues.clue: Beyonce co-wrote and sang this new song for 2019's The Lion King.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Spirit! [excited] It plays as Simba heads home to face Scar. Goosebumps, every single time.

clues.clue: In the 2017 Beauty and the Beast, the Beast gets this brand-new solo ballad by Alan Menken and Tim Rice.
choices: How Does a Moment Last Forever
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Evermore! [whispers] If I Can't Love Her was the Beast's ballad in the Broadway show. Tricky, tricky.
